# meshed

> Link functions up into callable objects


## Pages in this subsection

- [meshed](meshed.html.md): &#96;meshed&#96; contains a set of tools that allow the developer to provide a collection
- [meshed.base](meshed.base.html.md): Define &#96;FuncNode&#96;, the unit of computation that &#96;meshed&#96; assembles into DAGs.
- [meshed.cached_dag](meshed.cached_dag.html.md): Compute any var node of a DAG from what it depends on, caching what was computed.
- [meshed.caching](meshed.caching.html.md): Turn functions into cached properties of a class.
- [meshed.components](meshed.components.html.md): Ready-made extraction components for meshed graphs.
- [meshed.composition](meshed.composition.html.md): Specific use of FuncNode and DAG
- [meshed.dag](meshed.dag.html.md): Making DAGs
- [meshed.ext](meshed.ext.html.md): | &#96;gk&#96;   | This module is meant to explore a different representation of a computation graph and a d...
- [meshed.ext.gk](meshed.ext.gk.html.md): This module is meant to explore a different representation of a computation graph
- [meshed.itools](meshed.itools.html.md): Graph operations over adjacency mappings.
- [meshed.makers](meshed.makers.html.md): This module contains tools to make meshed objects in different ways.
- [meshed.slabs](meshed.slabs.html.md): Tools to generate slabs.
- [meshed.tools](meshed.tools.html.md): Tools to work with meshed
- [meshed.util](meshed.util.html.md): Function-wrapping, naming, and small data helpers shared across &#96;meshed&#96;.
- [meshed.viz](meshed.viz.html.md): Visualization utilities for the meshed package.
